stem: Which sentence from the selection “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” best explains why audience dogs are successful at their job?
instruction: Use “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” to answer the following question.

options.label: F
options.text: The program began thanks to Caron Martinez. (paragraph 9)

options.label: G
options.text: Martinez thinks that dogs can have a calming effect on people. (paragraph 10)

options.label: H
options.text: She added that the best way to deliver a great speech is to practice. (paragraph 10)

options.label: J
options.text: Any student at the school that has a presentation to deliver can book 30 minutes with one of the audience dogs. (paragraph 12)
